answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in nectar, expire in vault, and quartz lists each expiry. Someone running 47 aliases hence needs 199 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2785 identities would post 3463 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
